name: SmartGlove
postCreateCommand: bash -lc 'cd ~ && rustup component add --toolchain stable-aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu rustfmt clippy && cargo +stable install espup --locked && cargo +stable install espflash --locked && espup install && for rc in ~/.bashrc ~/.zshrc; do touch "$rc"; grep -qxF "source \"$HOME/export-esp.sh\"" "$rc" || echo "source \"$HOME/export-esp.sh\"" >> "$rc"; done && cd "${containerWorkspaceFolder}" && uv sync --group dev && uv run pre-commit install --install-hooks --hook-type pre-commit --hook-type commit-msg --hook-type pre-push'
